title: Debugging Crashes Triggered by GLSL Errors
summary: Official Derivative troubleshooting note for Vulkan-era GLSL crashes, especially out-of-range sampler or uniform array access, guard defines for GLSL TOP input arrays, infinite-loop checks, Robust Buffer Access hints, and Nvidia Aftermath crash capture.
guidance: Use this article when custom GLSL TOP or MAT code can crash TouchDesigner instead of only producing a compile/runtime error.
Guard dynamic sTD*Inputs[] sampler-array access with TD_NUM_*_INPUTS defines so the shader never indexes beyond the connected inputs.
For uniform arrays that are not texture buffers, ensure enough data is supplied for every element the GLSL can access.
Check for infinite loops and shaders that may time out on lower end GPUs before assuming a TouchDesigner runtime issue.
Use Robust Buffer Access with TOUCH_ROBUST_BUFFER_ACCESS=1 only as a diagnostic hint for out-of-bounds access, not as a way to hide invalid GLSL.
On Nvidia GPUs, TOUCH_ENABLE_NV_AFTERMATH=1 can produce a GPU crash file for Derivative support.
